content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Show the number of property sales in 2022 and in 2023, and the percentage change from 2022 to 2023.

content.statement:
WITH sales_2022 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
        ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
        METRICS sales_count
        WHERE uk_price_paid.year = 2022
    )
),
sales_2023 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
        ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
        METRICS sales_count
        WHERE uk_price_paid.year = 2023
    )
)
SELECT
    2022 AS year_2022,
    2023 AS year_2023,
    sales_2022.sales_count AS sales_count_2022,
    sales_2023.sales_count AS sales_count_2023,
    sales_2023.sales_count - sales_2022.sales_count AS absolute_change,
    (sales_2023.sales_count - sales_2022.sales_count) / NULLIF(sales_2022.sales_count, 0) AS pct_change
FROM sales_2022
CROSS JOIN sales_2023

;
